description: Use this when the user wants their own agent tested on everyday jobs with planted traps, refereed from the end state. Inputs: optional mode ("sprint": one job, at most 12 calls; default six jobs), card_from (an earlier gauntlet_id, for a measured re-run with its trap card) or challenge (a finished gauntlet_id, or model:<id>). Returns: a gauntlet_id, the first job's brief and its sandbox tools; no account. Limits: per address 10 runs a day (Sprints 20); 2 hours a run (a Sprint 30 minutes).

challenge.description: A finished gauntlet_id, or model:<id> for a headline model's stored runs

mode.description: "sprint": one job with one planted trap (ADR 0083); "full" (the default): six jobs

title: Start the Forge Gauntlet
